title: Time-Decay Estimates for Two-Dimensional Fourth-Order Schrödinger Operators with Threshold Singularities
summary: We establish time-decay estimates for the two-dimensional fourth-order Schrödinger operator $H=Δ^2+V$ with a real-valued decaying potential $V$, covering all possible zero-energy threshold obstructions. When zero is a regular point or a first-kind resonance, we prove \[ \left\| H^{\fracα{4}}e^{-itH}P_{\mathrm{ac}}(H) \right\|_{L^1\to L^\infty} \lesssim |t|^{-\frac{2+α}{4}}, \qquad -2 0$: \[ \left\| ω^{-s} H^{\fracα{4}}e^{-itH}P_{\mathrm{ac}}(H)ω^{-s} \right\|_{L^1\to L^\infty} \lesssim \frac{1} {|t|^{\frac{2+α}{4}}(\log|t|)^s}, \qquad |t|\geq2, \] where $ω(x)=\log(2+|x|)$.
